Yash's New Film 'Toxic' Unveils Female Cast Teaser

The makers of Yash's upcoming film 'Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups' have released a teaser featuring its female cast, including Rukmini Vasanth, Nayanthara, Tara Sutaria, Huma Qureshi, and Kiara Advani. The teaser highlights the action-packed nature of the film. The release comes ahead of the film's scheduled release date.
